title: Uncollected Store Pickup Orders and the Marlowe & Finch Alterations Deposit Rate
content:
An uncollected-order addition is made to the deposit rate of a Marlowe & Finch Alterations ticket from the customer's Marlowe & Finch refunds made because a store pickup order was never collected, dated less than 24 whole months before today.

| Such refunds dated less than 24 whole months before today | Uncollected-order addition to the deposit rate |
|---|---|
| two | 20 percentage points |
| one | 10 percentage points |
| none | none |
| three or more | none |

**Records read.** The refunds on the customer's Merchandise Purchases records, the reason recorded for each refund (a store pickup order never collected) and the refund date. A refund for any other reason does not count.

## The window, both sides

- A qualifying refund dated 23 whole months before today counts.
- A qualifying refund dated 24 whole months or more before today does not count.

## Hypothetical illustrations

- One refund for a never-collected pickup order dated 10 months ago and one for a returned item dated 3 months ago: one qualifying refund, 10 percentage points.
- Two refunds for never-collected pickup orders dated 5 and 18 months ago: 20 percentage points.
- A refund for a never-collected pickup order dated 30 months ago and no other: none.
- Three refunds for never-collected pickup orders, all dated within the last year: none.
